finding.ownership_precheck_binding: The exact wrappers carry task_id but no authenticated owner/principal field. Therefore the prior fail-closed ownership rule binds cleanly to params.task_id plus a server-authenticated principal obtained from RequestContext/transport extensions. _meta is request metadata and must not be treated as identity authority. For tasks/get, ownership must be checked before any task-store read that could disclose another principal's task. For tasks/update, ownership must be checked before consuming or applying input_responses. For tasks/cancel, ownership must be checked before any cancellation/store mutation. This is an application-level safety requirement, not a stock rmcp ownership guarantee.
